* feat(os): desktop dock with Ino first and a first-run greeting

IAgent.Post records an assistant-only entry without a model call (idempotent by id);
the chat shows it as one assistant bubble. Desktop.FirstRun opens Ino once per brain
(durable <desktop>/greeted) and asks it to greet, pointing to the apps gallery.

* fix(os): first run never skips start; posted runs are explicit

AgentRun.Posted marks IAgent.Post entries (stored as post/{id}); only those drop the
user bubble, so attachment-only turns keep theirs. Post is rejected while a run is
active; the desktop retries the greeting on the next start until it exists. Dock

* fix(shell): watch viewports and the v2 kinds the server composes

The shell's NodeContracts table had no entry for viewport, toggle, progress,
infobar, image or expander, so watching the workspace canvas (a viewport)
threw "Unknown app UI kind" and no app view rendered in the browser: the
root cause of every ShippedAppFacts timeout. A drift fact now requires a
contract for every kind a view or composition may reference.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(desktop): the shell's width hint replaces the narrow toggle

The dock no longer shows a "One window" button. When the desktop is the
root, the shell sends the desktop's `narrow` request (true below 900
logical px) when it mounts and whenever the window crosses 900; narrow.cs
handles that request and re-renders only on change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(desktop): an empty desktop keeps the dock at the bottom

With no window open the desktop column held only the dock, so it rendered
at the top of the screen. It now keeps the empty window area above the
dock with the same extents as when windows are open.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ui): a view retains its last change for watches opened later

A shell that read a view and then opened its Watch missed any publish in
between: views retained no signal, so the server's replay on open had
nothing to send and the page kept the stale tree (the reloaded desktop
never showed its re-rendered dock). The view now retains its last
ViewChanged, stamped with its publisher and sequenced by a publication
counter small enough for a web client.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(e2e): desktop journey

The shipped-app journeys now open each app as a desktop window from the
gallery's Open; the service apps the desktop never windows (router,
selfimprove, circleroom, usage) still run on the classic Workspace. The
classic stopgap is gone. A classic smoke fact keeps v1 covered, and a
browser journey goes start -> Ino's greeting -> gallery (Built-in, Mine,
From others) -> Get Calculator into a second window -> close -> Classic
layout -> New desktop.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(desktop): every window gives its app's view a bounded area

Windows sat in a scrolling list with intrinsic-height cards, so an app
view that expands (Ino's chat) got an unbounded height: the debug shell
threw layout assertions, Ino's window stayed empty and later clicks were
lost. Window rows now share the window area, and each window is a fixed
chrome card above its content, which fills the rest.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(desktop): version 0.1.1 so brains that have the desktop take its fixes

Shipped updates are version-gated: a brain already holding desktop 0.1.0
kept the old window layout and dock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(architecture): record the view state's additive Changes field

Changes has a new id; state saved before it reads 0, which the retained
ViewChanged treats as the first publication.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(desktop): trust the desktop by its shipped origin, not its name

Connect chooses the v2 desktop root only when apps/desktop is the shipped,
unedited desktop from a trusted publisher; otherwise it logs and shows the
classic root. The workspace neuron applies navigation state only for the
shipped workspace or desktop app. Adds a fact that a brain holding desktop
0.1.0 takes 0.1.1 on connect.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(apps): only the person or the shipped desktop installs from the store

Get refuses any app caller other than the shipped, unedited desktop of the
store's brain; List answers nothing outside the store's own brain, the same
scope check Get makes.

Message:
rename: DigitalBrain to IntoChat.OS

Mechanical rename by scripts/rename/rename-tokens.ps1 (stage rename) plus the
exception table; one atomic, buildable commit on top of the alias commits.

- 2,248 paths moved (134 directories, 147 file basenames, DigitalBrain.slnx ->
  Intochat.OS.slnx, digitalbrain.cs -> intochat-os.cs), 2,095 files edited.
- Rule counts: R6 dotted 8776, R7 identifier 1294, R8 bare 461, K1 kernel 172,
  L8 camel 63, R2 env 31, P1 plural 22, L5/L6/L7 lowercase 105, others < 40.
- Kernel host project DigitalBrain.OS -> IntoChat.OS.Kernel (owner ruling);
  solution folder /OS/ -> /Kernel/ to match RepositoryLayoutFacts.
- Identifiers DigitalBrain -> IntoChatOS (IIntoChatOS, IIntoChatOSBrains,
  AddIntoChatOSServer, IntoChatOSNames ...); MSBuild IntoChatOS* properties;
  INTOCHATOS_* env family; .intochat-os state directory; LOCALAPPDATA IntoChatOS.
- proto: only option csharp_namespace changes (IntoChat.OS.Authority.Neurons.Proto);
  package digitalbrain; and the /digitalbrain.Neurons/* route stay for Plan 04.
- Frozen strings DigitalBrain.OwnerKeys.v3 and "DigitalBrain deployment key
  binding v1" are untouched.
- Pinned lists recaptured with scripts/capture-all.ps1 (snapshot S2).
  rename-proof.py rename S1 S2: OK, zero value differences, Golden.cs identical
  apart from its namespace line.
- Tests (Release): architecture 103 total / 96 passed / 0 failed / 7 skipped;
  all 36 Tests.Unit/Integration executables green (no failures).
- Expected value changes inside tests, not contract values: legacy pre-alias
  enum hex in FlutterWireNameFacts (type name inside the bytes) and the pinned
  Orleans invokable ids of the test grain IMarkedWork (signature hash includes
  the declaring type name). Both recorded as rows in rename-exceptions.tsv.
- Deferred: config prefix DigitalBrain: / DigitalBrain__ and config roots
  (Plan 05, stage config); Dart pub names, barrels, pubspec.lock, generated
  neurons.pb*.dart, proto package, Windows runner (Plan 04).

Message:
Deploy DigitalBrain to Azure from its Aspire manifest with Pulumi and DeploymentKit

- DigitalBrain.Deployment: reads the AppHost manifest, lays the foundation with DeploymentKit
  (preview.3, with its missing slot/traffic registrations supplied), runs the runtime on a
  workload-profiles Container Apps environment with a managed identity, vaults every secret-bearing
  environment value in Key Vault and fails up front on anything no module provides
- Modules own their deployments via [ModuleDeployment]: Memory (Qdrant), ClickHouse, Compute
  (ledger on the kit's PostgreSQL), AI (Ollama with manifest models), CSharp (session pool in an
  isolated environment, HTTPS-only egress, Session Executor role, secret run-token key)
- IntoChat.Deployment Pulumi program and README; Pulumi-mock tests over the hosted manifest
- Sandbox Dockerfile.production bakes the client and module contracts into /brain
